pain_point: Cash flow concerns during construction - If I buy off the plan when do I actually start paying? I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time
headline_pain: Think You Can't Afford to Buy?
primary_text: "I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time." Neither could the dozens of small business owners who've already bought in Truganina — and they didn't have to. Here's how off-the-plan works: you put down a deposit to lock in your price. During the 12-18 month construction period, you pay nothing else. You keep renting your current space. When the warehouse is finished, you settle and start your mortgage — your rent stops the same month. Many buyers find their mortgage repayment is similar to or less than what they were paying in rent. No overlap. No stress. Get the numbers for your situation.
description: Many buyers find mortgage repayments match or beat their current rent
